snippet.title: Skirmish Mayhem: Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Skirmish Mayhem is an action strategy game where you equip and upgrade an arsenal of weapons, construct a base and build an army to defend against waves of enemies. 3 factions are waging war, fight for your faction, unlock powerful commanders, tech-up and become an all-powerful force.


Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124150/Skirmish_Mayhem/
